note: Skills maintained outside this repository. Every entry was fetched and then independently re-verified on 2026-09-19. Nothing here is vendored: this repository references these skills and records their provenance, it does not copy their contents or run their installers. An agent uses one only if the user has installed it; when it is absent, the fallback applies and the work continues.

trust_levels.official: Published by the vendor whose product the skill covers.
trust_levels.verified: Published by a vendor-affiliated org, but with a licence or provenance caveat recorded in the entry.
trust_levels.community: Individual or small-team maintainer. Never required, never automatically activated.
trust_levels.local: Authored in this repository — see catalog/skills.json.
